raw_feedback_text: A Z-branch layout with a heavy valve on the branch horizontal leg selected F2 without a specific evidence basis and placed the branch entry/valve outside the top-frame span. By default the branch connection and branch valve must be inside GD-ST, and F2/F2D must not be selected unless evidence justifies the low-strain pocket and header-strain penalty.

structured_feedback.affected_requirement: Branch-owned valve layouts must use compatible ILT-L/ILT-Z anchors and keep tee, valve, and end inside GD-ST.
structured_feedback.affected_function: select top-frame connection system and branch geometry using standard-layout precedent and strain/moment evidence
structured_feedback.affected_behavior: avoid unjustified F2/F2D stiffness paths that create header strain penalties when no low-strain pocket is required
structured_feedback.affected_structure: GD-B; GD-ST; GD-Con; branch valve on horizontal leg
structured_feedback.affected_constraint: Require connection-system basis for F2/F2D and require GD-ST span containment for branch tee, valve, and end.
structured_feedback.pmap_issue: The previous plotted concept was buildable but not workflow-valid because standard ILT-Z anchor precedent and branch-valve containment were not enforced.
